content:
name: Coro
options:
  bundleIdPrefix: org.proyectocoro
  deploymentTarget:
    iOS: "26.0"
packages:
  LyricsCore:
    path: .
settings:
  base:
    SWIFT_VERSION: "5.0"
    TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY: "1"
    CODE_SIGN_STYLE: Automatic
    MARKETING_VERSION: "0.1.1"
    CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION: "2"
    IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: "26.0"
    GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: NO
targets:
  Coro:
    type: application
    platform: iOS
    sources:
      - path: App
        excludes:
          - Info.plist
      - path: Shared
      - path: Resources
        buildPhase: resources
    info:
      path: App/Info.plist
      properties:
        CFBundleDisplayName: Coro
        CFBundleShortVersionString: "0.1.1"
        CFBundleVersion: "2"
        UILaunchScreen: {}
        UISupportedInterfaceOrientations:
          - UIInterfaceOrientationPortrait
        UIBackgroundModes:
          - audio
        NSSupportsLiveActivities: true
        NSSupportsLiveActivitiesFrequentUpdates: true
        CoroProjectURL: "$(CORO_PROJECT_URL)"
        NSAppTransportSecurity:
          NSAllowsLocalNetworking: true
        UIApplicationSceneManifest:
          UIApplicationSupportsMultipleScenes: false
    settings:
      base:
        PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: org.proyectocoro.app
        ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME: AppIcon
        CORO_PROJECT_URL: ""
    dependencies:
      - package: LyricsCore
      - target: CoroLive
        embed: true
  CoroLive:
    type: app-extension
    platform: iOS
    sources:
      - path: Widget
        excludes:
          - Info.plist
      - path: Shared
    info:
      path: Widget/Info.plist
      properties:
        CFBundleDisplayName: Coro Live
        CFBundleShortVersionString: "0.1.1"
        CFBundleVersion: "2"
        NSExtension:
          NSExtensionPointIdentifier: com.apple.widgetkit-extension
    settings:
      base:
        PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: org.proyectocoro.app.live
        SKIP_INSTALL: YES
        APPLICATION_EXTENSION_API_ONLY: YES
schemes:
  Coro:
    build:
      targets:
        Coro: all
    run:
      config: Debug
    archive:
      config: Release
